HOME.TERMS_CONTENT_HEADER: Privacy statement (GDPR) for users of Varmtarbeid AS’s app and web portal solutions
HOME.TERMS_CONTENT_PARA1: Varmtarbeid AS protects the privacy of its users, their contact persons and stakeholders. This privacy policy explains how Varmtarbeid AS collects and uses personal data, as well as the users rights.
HOME.TERMS_CONTENT_PARA2: Varmtarbeid AS is considered the data controller according to the Personal Data Act and the EU's General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), for the processing of personal data Varmtarbeid AS carries out in connection with the conclusion and fulfillment of agreements and other contact with users etc. As the data controller, Varmtarbeid AS is required to process personal data in accordance with the Personal Data Act, GDPR and other laws and regulations applicable at any time.
HOME.TERMS_CONTENT_PARA3: In cases where Varmtarbeid AS uses other suppliers, and these process the personal data of the users, their contact persons and stakeholders, Varmtarbid AS's supplier has corresponding obligations regarding the processing of personal data.
HOME.TERMS_CONTENT_PARA4: This is an overview of the personal data we process about our users, their contact persons and stakeholders:
HOME.TERMS_CONTENT_PARA5_LIST1: Name, organization no. or date of birth, identification from the account applicant, user number, telephone number and e-mail address(es), as well as any contact person(s) with corresponding contact details.
HOME.TERMS_CONTENT_PARA5_LIST3: Information on contractual relationships; payment and invoicing conditions, as well as user contact with information from e-mail, contact form, SMS and telephone.
HOME.TERMS_CONTENT_PARA5_LIST4: Names of users of Varmtarbeid AS's web portal and app with username, password and the following usage information: IP address, browser type, local preferences, mobile operator, information about system configuration, and other interaction with the services, including scope of use, which functions are used and usage patterns.
HOME.TERMS_CONTENT_PARA6_LIST1: If you contact Varmtarbeid AS for an offer, we will process your name or organization number, user number, contact person(s), telephone number and e-mail address(es), as well as the result of the credit assessment.
HOME.TERMS_CONTENT_PARA6_LIST2: If you contact us with requests for information or anything else, we will process the information you provide in order to be able to answer and follow up the inquiry.
HOME.TERMS_CONTENT_PARA7: Varmtarbeid AS collects, stores and uses personal data to provide Varmtarbeid AS's app and web portal solutions with functionality such as place and date, as well as the time. And to register certificates and their expiry dates, as well as send communication messages between clients and users, as well as store these.In addition, reports and statistics are prepared to evaluate, improve and develop our existing and new offers and marketing activities. Varmtarbeid AS can also contact the clients and their contact persons for marketing via e-mail, as well as use other collected data in functionality development and marketing initiatives towards third parties, for example towards the clients in the application.
HOME.TERMS_CONTENT_PARA8: The clients must ensure that there is a valid consent or other legal basis for the processing of the personal data that is entered into Varmtarbeid AS's databases, if the user has not himself/herself accepted Varmtarbeid AS's privacy policy.
HOME.TERMS_CONTENT_PARA9: Personal data is stored and processed within the EU/EEA area or third-party countries according to the standard EU model agreement in accordance with applicable privacy legislation. Varmtarbeid AS processes the information as long as the purpose of the processing requires it (up to 5 years). After this, the information is deleted in a safe and secure manner, unless it is anonymised or there is another basis for storing the information longer.
HOME.TERMS_CONTENT_PARA10: The legal basis for processing personal data is mainly the conclusion and fulfillment of user agreements. When it comes to other inquiries and contact, the basis will be consent or a balancing of interests. Varmtarbeid AS has assessed that there is a legitimate interest in answering and following up inquiries, as well as sending out marketing, newsletters and providing information about our business to our users, unless they have made a reservation. In addition, Varmtarbeid AS has assessed that there is a legitimate interest in using social media and cookies on our websites, as stated on the relevant platforms.
HOME.TERMS_CONTENT_PARA11: All registered users have the right to receive information about which personal data is processed by Varmtarbeid AS, upon enquiry. All data subjects also have the right to request that personal data should be deleted or that incorrect personal data should be corrected. Deletion of personal data cannot be done if this is required to fulfill the agreement or otherwise appears from Norwegian law or a court or authority decision.In some cases, you have the right to data portability of your personal data. You also have the right to withdraw any consents, oppose automatic decision-making processes and profiling. In order to use such rights, you must confirm your identity. See contact information at the bottom of this privacy statement.
HOME.TERMS_CONTENT_PARA12: If you believe that Varmtarbeid AS's processing of your personal data violates privacy legislation, you can complain to the Norwegian Data Protection Authority.
HOME.TERMS_CONTENT_PARA13: Changes in Varmtarbeid AS's operations, or changes in the regulations on the processing of personal data, may result in changes to this information.
